decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor builds on established sports flooring competence and costs little to keep listed, so the option is worth holding despite no evidence after 2019.
The mobile arena floor serves a niche project market where demand resolves slowly, and carrying it costs little.
It overlaps with B, which makes consolidation plausible, but there is no clear signal that its value has failed, so the option is kept for now.
The chevron parquet is the flagship and fits the firm's trend-led residential direction squarely, with prominent home-page placement.
The squash court finish is a low-cost add-on to the sports range, so keeping it preserves the option at minimal carrying cost.
The oak skirting is a cheap complementary accessory supporting the sports floor systems, so dropping it would release few resources.
